high_level_description: This image depicts a staircase adorned with decorative elements that create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The staircase is made of speckled stone or concrete and has a railing on the left side. Along the left side of the stairs, there are small, lit candles placed at regular intervals, casting a soft, golden glow that illuminates the steps. These candles are arranged neatly, creating a path of light leading up to the top of the stairs. On the right side of the staircase, there are several potted plants, each housed in white ceramic pots.
